purpose: The cross-examination showcase. Every contradiction here is between what the vendor claims and what the vendor's own evidence records, which is what makes the finding defensible rather than inferred.

required_findings.note: The questionnaire claims organisation-wide MFA. Exception note 3.2 of the audit report records that MFA is not enforced for administrative access and was unremediated at period end.
ISO certificate ISO-27001-DD-2298 expired 14 March 2025. A date comparison, so this is a guaranteed finding rather than a hoped-for one.

The questionnaire claims a 24-hour notification window. The incident sheet records 9 days from detection to disclosure. Medium on the commitment anchor rather than high: the disclosure process exists and ran, and what the evidence contradicts is the timeframe the vendor committed to, not the presence of the control.

The report period ended 30 June 2025, one month past the 12-month currency threshold. Severity is graded on the overrun: a report a month out of date and one three years out of date are not the same finding, and nothing in this report records a control that failed.

Sendline Notifications receives recipient names, phone numbers, email addresses and delivery windows for every shipment DataDynamo handles, and it is not on this organisation's approved-vendor register. Nobody here has reviewed it and there is no record of anything ever having been signed with it. A set difference against an internal system, so the finding is source=rule and reproducible without a model.

Wayfarer Geocoding is on this organisation's approved-vendor register and its review lapsed on 30 September 2025, while it continues to receive origin and destination addresses through DataDynamo. Somebody did the work once and the paperwork went stale, which is a lower severity than never having reviewed them at all. A date comparison against an internal register, so the finding is source=rule.

The answer states an RTO of 8 hours and a last recovery test 'in 2024'. Section 7 of the report records that no recovery test was performed during the period and that the most recent one on record predates it. A currency gap rather than a control failure: the objective is stated and undisputed, and what is missing is evidence that it was ever exercised.

followups.reason: Four answers land below the confidence threshold, so each draws one targeted follow-up that quotes the vendor's own words back and names the evidence required. DP01 is the one the demo reads out: 'We follow industry best practice for encryption both at rest and in transit' is the exact non-answer that makes manual chasing the pain this project removes.

subprocessors.note: Two gaps of different kinds, which is why this vendor carries the beat. Sendline Notifications receives every recipient address DataDynamo handles and has never been reviewed here at all; Wayfarer Geocoding was reviewed once and the paperwork lapsed. Everything is inside the EU, so residency raises nothing. The headline case fires on a vendor that completes a review locally, which is what makes it demonstrable rather than described.

assertions: The MFA contradiction is present with domain=access_control, severity=high, contradiction=true and source=model.
That finding's evidence_ref resolves to a real chunk whose text contains both 'exception' and 'mfa'.
The expired certificate finding carries source=rule, not source=model.
The review re-tiers from 2 to 1, plan_version becomes 2, and a TierChange records the answer that caused it.
Questions carried over from plan v1 are not re-sent: the vendor receives the original set plus the new domain's set, and nothing twice.
Exactly one targeted follow-up is sent for DP01, quoting the vendor's own answer, and never more than the cap.
A follow-up outstanding on DP01 does not stop the review reaching the coverage threshold.
The band is conditional, and the score sits at least four points inside it at both ends.
No Adversarial Conduct flag is raised.
The fourth-party diff runs against the approved-vendor register and raises two findings, both source=rule.
The fourth_party_gap beat fires, naming Sendline Notifications and what it receives.
